title: Crisis Communication Skills
overview: This course equips participants with the tools to understand how a crisis can affect an organization and the strategies necessary to mitigate its impacts. The focus is on preparing the communication function to respond swiftly and effectively during a crisis, enabling effective management of public perceptions in the media and online.

Participants will gain insights into best practices for crisis communication management, including situation analysis, risk assessment, crisis team formation and responsibilities, protocols, and essential resources like crisis manuals and communication tools
audience: This course is designed for team leaders, supervisors, and managers in public relations, as well as any staff members involved in handling communication challenges during a crisis.
methodology: The workshop is interactive and participatory, utilizing a variety of educational and training tools. It incorporates real-life case studies to help participants translate theory into practical application effectively and efficiently.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify the various types of crises and their characteristics
List key principles of crisis communication
Develop crisis management processes to mitigate potential crises within their organizations
Demonstrate the advantages of leveraging media during a crisis
Evaluate and prioritize the aspects involved in crisis communication management
Analyze and interpret results from crisis communication efforts

items.text: Media as a partner in crisis response
Social media: a tool or a challenge?
Dynamic use of social media in crisis communication
Determining timing, budget, and measurement tools
Analyzing results for insights and recommendations
